blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.
blocks.zh: 医学3D扫描和报告本质上是分级的,诊断提示集中在组织多个层次的特定解剖区. 然而,大多数医学视觉语言模型忽略了这种结构,未能专注于临床相关的解剖学. 我们引入了MedHiVE,它结合了等级视觉语言Soft Mixture-of-Experts(SMoE)与对比性学习,联合模型化精细解剖学和全球扫描背景. 据我们所知,MedHiVE是第一个通过解剖尺度组织的双层SMOE结构来引导视觉和文字符号的框架,它与3D医学成像的报告生成的解剖学-水平对比性对齐。 这取代了静态集合特征的直接区域文本调整和以往工作的仅愿景分级路径,代之以动态的、基于时间档的跨解剖尺度的跨模式信息流动。 MedHiVE通过两级可学习的符号路由机制运作,其中本地图像和文本特征首先通过本地的SMOE进行路由,然后被全球的SMOE融合成统一的多式联运表示. 相互矛盾的学习使解剖学层面和全球视觉语言在统一空间中的表述一致。 MeDHIVE通过解剖学监督对25,000+CT扫描进行预先培训,在6个数据集中持续超过11个最先进的方法,涉及3项任务:分割、分类和检测,表明分级模型的重要性。 MedHive的代码在github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHive上.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Three-dimensional (3D) computed tomography (CT) data possess an intrinsic, multi-scale hierarchical structure where local voxel-level textures are nested within anatomical organs, which in turn follow a natural spatial arrangement within the body. Clinical text mirrors this hierarchy, as reports are typically organized into organ-specific findings and global impressions. Unifying these domains requires learning joint representations that bridge fine-grained anatomical details with holistic bodily context, a balance that remains a key challenge for medical vision-language models.

blocks.en: While recent progress in vision-language (VL) models has revolutionized natural image understanding, standard 3D medical approaches often treat volumes and reports as flat sequences, effectively discarding these essential structural inductive biases [ 19 ] . The MambaHoME architecture [ 36 ] recently introduced hierarchical routing, but solely for vision inputs, and the challenge of jointly modeling vision-language cross-modal hierarchies in a unified representation remains an open problem. Existing medical VL models have largely focused either on global alignment [ 7 ] or localized patches [ 52 ] . More recent efforts introduce anatomy-aware priors [ 47 , 41 , 10 ] , yet they frequently treat image and text hierarchies as separate or auxiliary concerns. To the best of our knowledge, no previous work has unified the hierarchical routing of 3D vision tokens with the semantic hierarchy of clinical reports into a single, differentiable framework for image analysis.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近在视觉语言(VL)模型方面取得的进展使自然图像的理解发生了革命性的变化,但标准的3D医疗方法往往将卷和报告视为平整的序列,有效地抛弃了这些基本的结构性诱导偏差[19]. 曼巴HOME架构[36]最近引入了分级路由,但仅用于视觉投入,在统一代表制中联合建模视觉语言跨模式分级制的挑战仍然是一个公开的问题. 现有的医疗VL模型主要侧重于全球对接[7]或局部补丁[52]. 最近的努力引入了解剖学认识前科[47,41,10],然而它们经常将图像和文本分级视为单独的或辅助的考虑. 据我们所知,以前没有一部作品将3D视觉符号的分级路由与临床报告的语义分级统一为一个单一的,不同的图像分析框架.

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we introduce MedHiVE,
a Med ical Hi erarchical V ision–Language E xperts framework, designed to exploit multi-scale structural priors.
We encode each CT volume and its report into global and anatomy-level representations, using a long-context text encoder [ 28 ] for the report and voxel-wise organ masks for the volume. We propose a hierarchical multimodal encoder with two-level, slot-based Soft MoE routing over global tokens and anatomy-level representations from both vision and text.
Global vision tokens and paired global text tokens are softly grouped and processed by global experts, while anatomy-level image and text representations are handled in parallel by local experts. These global and anatomy-aware slots are concatenated and routed through a second SMoE layer with shared experts for joint vision–language processing.
To enrich learned representations, we apply a contrastive loss to align vision-language representations on both local and global scales. Our main contributions are as follows: 1. Hierarchical vision–language architecture operating on anatomy-level representations and global tokens from both vision and text, using slot-based SMoE routing through anatomy-specific and global vision and language experts . 2. Local-global vision–language contrastive learning that jointly optimizes scan–report and anatomy–snippet objectives, aligning representations across global and anatomical scales . 3. Anatomy-aware supervision that combines organ masks with automatically extracted organ-specific report snippets, enabling organ-level alignment without sentence-level labels .

blocks.en: We pre-train MedHiVE on a large-scale, publicly available dataset comprising over 25,000 CT scans with reports and demonstrate consistent gains over state-of-the-art in downstream tasks like segmentation, classification, and detection. Beyond improving segmentation accuracy, MedHiVE provides a mechanism for transferring knowledge from free-form reports into 3D representations.
blocks.zh: 我们通过大规模、公开的数据集对MedHiVE进行预先培训,包括25 000多张带报告的CT扫描,并显示在分解、分类和检测等下游任务中,与最新技术相比取得了持续的进展。 除了提高分解准确性外,MedHive还提供了一个将知识从自由格式报告转移到三维表达的机制.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Medical Vision-Language Models (MedVLMs). The emergence of VLMs has catalyzed a shift toward multimodal supervised learning, mapping heterogeneous data into a unified latent space [ 37 , 51 , 26 ] . In the medical domain, research has evolved from 2D radiograph alignment [ 20 ] to complex 3D volumetric analysis. However, 3D VLMs remain non-trivial due to the semantic density bottleneck [ 10 ] . Recent state-of-the-art 3D MedVLMs address this challenge by improving the quality and scalability of visual representations [ 6 , 16 , 10 ] . They enhance the signal-to-noise ratio of visual features; for instance, [ 10 ] utilize anatomical normality modeling via VQ-VAEs to amplify abnormal signals. fVLM [ 41 ] is proposed to match anatomical regions with descriptions while calibrating for false negatives. Despite these advances, fVLM aligns each anatomical region through fixed, non-parametric pooling at a single level, which leaves the relationship between global physiological context and discrete anatomical structures unresolved. Anatomical normality modeling [ 10 ] likewise treats each anatomy in isolation, enhancing per-anatomy semantics through a multi-stage training pipeline before report alignment. To bridge this gap, we introduce an end-to-end framework that jointly routes anatomy-level and global tokens through learned experts. By capturing both local anatomical details and global physiological context within a single, unified representation, our approach replaces isolated per-anatomy alignment and multi-stage training with learned fusion of anatomy-level and global tokens, while explicitly resolving multi-scale relationships. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). MoE [ 22 ] decomposes a task by combining multiple specialized sub-networks (i.e., experts) within a single architecture. Sparsely gated MoE layers [ 40 , 38 , 5 , 49 ] enable conditional computation by employing a learned router that activates only a sparse subset of experts per input token. This mechanism allows for a massive increase in model capacity while keeping the computational cost nearly constant. Despite their scaling advantages, sparse routers often introduce optimization challenges such as expert imbalance and training instability. Soft MoE [ 34 ] addresses these issues through a continuous assignment approach, passing weighted combinations of all tokens to each expert, thereby smoothing the optimization landscape while retaining throughput efficiency. While modern MoE was largely popularized by its success in Transformer-based LLMs [ 50 , 25 ] , the architecture has rapidly expanded into multimodal domains [ 29 , 24 ] , as well as medical imaging [ 45 , 36 , 43 ] , where expert specialization is particularly suited for learning from complex, high-dimensional biological patterns. In this work, we build upon these advancements,
employing a two-level Soft MoE routing mechanism to hierarchically align global and anatomy-specific features across 3D CT scans and medical reports.
blocks.zh:
医学视野-语言模型(MedVLMs). VLMs的出现催生了向多模式监督学习的转变,将各种数据映射到统一的潜伏空间[37、51、26]。 在医学领域,研究已从2D放射图对接[20]发展为复杂的3D卷理分析. 然而,由于语义密度的瓶颈[10],3D VLM仍为非三角. 最近最先进的3DMDVLM通过提高视觉表现的质量和可扩展性来应对这一挑战[6,16,10]. 它们加强了视觉特征的信号与噪声之比;例如,[10]通过VQ-VAE使用解剖常态模型来放大异常信号. fVLM [41]被提议在校正假底片的同时将解剖区域与描述相匹配. 尽管取得了这些进展,fVLM通过固定的,非参数的单相集合使每个解剖区域相协调,这使得全球生理背景与离散解剖结构之间的关系得不到解决. 解剖常态模型[10]同样孤立地对待每个解剖学,通过多阶段培训管道在报告对接前增强每个解剖学语义. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了一个端到端的框架,通过有学问的专家共同引导解剖学层面和全球的象征。 通过在单一、统一的代表性中捕捉地方解剖细节和全球生理背景,我们的方法用学习解剖学层面和全球符号的聚变取代了孤立的每个解剖学调整和多阶段培训,同时明确解决多层次的关系。 (原始内容存档于2013-10-10). Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). MOE [22]通过将多个专业子网络(即专家)合并在一个架构内来分解一个任务. Sparsely gateed MoE series [40, 38, 5, 49] 通过使用一个学习的路由器,每个输入符只激活一个稀少的子集专家,从而实现有条件的计算. 这种机制使得模型容量能够大规模地增加,同时使计算成本几乎保持不变。 尽管具有规模化的优势,但稀有的路由器往往引入专家失衡和培训不稳定等优化挑战. 软教育部[34]通过持续分派办法解决这些问题,将所有符号的加权组合传递给每位专家,从而在保持吞吐效率的同时平稳优化环境。 虽然现代教育部在基于变形器的LLMs[50,25]的成功在很大程度上被普及,但该建筑已迅速被扩展为多模式领域[29,24],以及医学成像[45,36,43],其中专家专业特别适合从复杂高维度生物模式学习. 在这项工作中,我们在这些进步的基础上再接再厉,
采用双层软 MoE通路机制,在3D CT扫描和医疗报告上分级地协调全球和解剖学特有特征.

blocks.en:
Contrastive learning in MedVLMs. Contrastive learning remains the primary objective for aligning medical images with clinical reports. While early methods focused on global alignment [ 52 , 20 ] , the field has recently shifted toward structural alignment to respect the inherent hierarchy of medical data. HiCLIP [ 14 ] pioneered this by using hierarchy-aware attention to capture nested relationships between multi-level visual features and text for 2D imaging. However, extending hierarchical attention to 3D medical analysis remains non-trivial due to the cubic growth of tokens in volumetric scans. Prior works such as GLoRIA [ 20 ] learn global and region-level vision-language alignment via attention mechanisms in 2D medical images, but do not generalize to dense 3D volumes or provide explicit hierarchical modeling and token-level routing across anatomical scales.
While recent 3D approaches like [ 41 ] and [ 10 ] have scaled pre-training to massive 3D datasets, they often rely on coarse-grained global alignment that may overlook fine-grained anatomical morphology. Our work bridges this gap by extending hierarchical contrastive alignment to 3D and introducing a learnable, token-level routing mechanism for multimodal fusion. Unlike the static hierarchical attention in HiCLIP, we rely on a two-level multimodal SMoE routing paradigm, allowing dynamic, slot-based information flow between holistic scan representations and anatomy-aware tokens while maintaining the scalability required for large-scale 3D pre-training.
blocks.zh:
医学和性价比LMs中的矛盾学习 矛盾学习仍然是将医疗图像与临床报告相匹配的首要目标. 虽然早期的方法侧重于全球对齐[52,20],但该领域最近已转向结构对齐,以尊重医疗数据的固有等级。 HICLIP [14]通过利用分级意识的注意来捕捉多层次视觉特征与文字之间的嵌入关系来进行2D成像,从而开创了这一点. 然而,由于体积扫描中信使的立方增长,将分级关注扩展至3D医学分析仍然是非三角性的. GLORIA [20]等前作通过2D医疗影像中的关注机制来学习全球和地区层面的视觉语言相接,但并不概括到密集的3D卷上,也不提供清晰的分级模型和符号层次跨解剖尺度的路由.
虽然最近的三维方法,如[41]和[10],已经将预训范围扩大到了大型三维数据集,但它们往往依赖于粗糙的、可能忽略了细微的解剖形态的全球性调整。 我们的工作弥补了这一差距,将等级对比性调整扩大到3D,并为多式聚变引入了可学习的、象征性的路由机制。 与HCLIP中的静态分级关注不同,我们依靠双层多模式SMoE通路范式,允许在整体扫描表示和解剖意识符号之间有动态的,基于槽的信息流,同时保持了大规模3D预训所需的可伸缩性.

Soft Mixture-of-Experts and Slot-Based Routing. To balance efficiency and capacity, we employ Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) layers with slot-based routing (see Figure 2 ). An SMoE layer consists of Experts: A set of E E parameterized feed-forward networks (FFNs); and Slots: A collection of P P learnable vectors acting as queries for grouping input tokens before expert processing. Given input tokens { u k } k = 1 K \{u_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} and slot-representation matrix 𝐄 ∈ ℝ P × d \mathbf{E}\in\mathbb{R}^{P\times d} (with P P slots), the soft assignment of token u k u_{k} to slot p ∈ { 1 , … , P } p\in\{1,\ldots,P\} is: 𝐀 [ k , p ] = exp ( ⟨ u k , 𝐄 [ p , : ] ⟩ ) ∑ p ′ = 1 P exp ( ⟨ u k , 𝐄 [ p ′ , : ] ⟩ ) . \mathbf{A}[k,p]=\frac{\exp(\langle u_{k},\mathbf{E}[p,:]\rangle)}{\sum_{p^{\prime}=1}^{P}\exp(\langle u_{k},\mathbf{E}[p^{\prime},:]\rangle)}. (3) Each slot aggregates the tokens via a sum weighted by the soft assignment values, and the resulting slot representations are processed by allocated experts.

blocks.en: Problem formulation. Our primary goal is to learn a model that captures multi-level image-text alignment, ensuring that both global representations ( z i I , z i T ) (z_{i}^{I},z_{i}^{T}) and anatomy-level representations ( z i , a I , z i , a T ) (z_{i,a}^{I},z_{i,a}^{T}) are semantically aligned across modalities. We use “global” to denote scan-level summaries and “local” to denote anatomy-conditioned regions; the same hierarchy is mirrored on the text side via report-level and snippet-level representations.

blocks.en: 4.2 The MedHiVE Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.2 医疗 建筑

blocks.en: We introduce MedHiVE, an encoder–decoder architecture featuring a newly designed MedHiVE Encoder that incorporates HiVEL, a Hierarchical Vision-Language Experts Layer, and applies contrastive learning to achieve multimodal representation alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 MedHive, 一种编码器-解码器架构, 由新设计的 MedHive Encoder 组成, 包含 HiveL, 一个等级视觉-语言专家层, 并应用对比性学习来实现多模式的表达对齐。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Encoder

We propose a multimodal MedHiVE Encoder, which extends the vision-only HoME Block of [ 36 ] with text routing, an anatomy expert stream, second-level cross-modal fusion, and contrastive alignment, illustrated in Figure 1 . For feature extraction at each encoder stage, we follow SegMamba [ 46 ] , applying
a 3D Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) block followed by flattening the feature map into 1D token sequences, normalization, a Mamba layer to capture long-range dependencies, and again normalization. The feature extraction step is followed by the HiVEL layer (see Figure 2 ), with additional inputs from text representations and local vision representations, as described below. The output of HiVEL is flattened and rearranged. Both normalization and Mamba layers, as well as normalization and HiVEL layers are wrapped in residual connections.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Decoder

After each MedHiVE stage, the fused vision tokens are reshaped back to the 3D grid to form the multi-scale feature maps 𝐅 ^ i ( s ) \hat{\mathbf{F}}_{i}^{(s)} , which are passed to a UNETR-based [ 17 , 36 ] decoder via skip connections for voxel-wise segmentation. At each resolution, the decoder upsamples the features and integrates the corresponding encoder-stage output.

blocks.en: MedHiVE jointly optimizes segmentation and hierarchical vision-language contrastive alignment. The objectives are designed to ensure that the learned representations encode both global semantics and anatomy-level grounding.

blocks.en: Global contrastive learning. Whole-image and whole-report representations ( z i I , z i T ) (z_{i}^{I},z_{i}^{T}) from the first MedHiVE stage ( s = 1 s=1 ) are aligned using a symmetric cosine InfoNCE loss [ 32 ] . blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup

blocks.en:
Datasets. To pre-train our model, we use the publicly available dataset Merlin [ 6 , 3 ] comprising 25,494 CT scans from 18,321 patients and their corresponding radiology reports. For fine-tuning, we use publicly available datasets for segmentation, including PANORAMA [ 1 ] , AMOS-CT [ 23 ] , and KiTS 2023 [ 18 ] . We curate two in-house abdominal CT datasets for (i) classification and detection of PDAC, and (ii) qualitative evaluation of kidney lesions against radiology reports (IRB approval no. 9/2023). The details about data preprocessing, pre-training, fine-tuning and test sets are provided in Appendix A and Appendix B . blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with state-of-the-art
blocks.zh: 5.2 与最新技术的比较

blocks.en: We compare our proposed model, MedHiVE, with several state-of-the-art methods, including Hermes [ 13 ] , Swin SMT [ 35 ] , VSmTrans [ 30 ] , uC 3DU-Net [ 21 ] , Swin UNETR [ 44 ] , SuPreM [ 27 ] , SegMamba [ 46 ] , and MambaHoME [ 36 ] , which is our baseline. Additionally, we compare MedHiVE with pre-trained MedVLMs, including Merlin [ 6 ] , fVLM [ 41 ] , and BTB3D [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们把我们提出的模型MedHive与几种最先进的方法进行比较,包括Hermes [13],Swin SMT [35],VSmTrans [30],uC 3DU-Net [21],Swin UNETR [44],SuPrem [27],SegMamba [46],和MambaHome [36],这是我们的基线. 此外,我们还将MedHive与预先训练过的MedVLM进行比较,包括Merlin [6],fVLM [41],和BTB3D [16].

blocks.en: Downstream tasks. We evaluate MedHiVE against state-of-the-art methods on segmentation, classification, and detection. For a fair comparison, all methods are pre-trained on the same dataset and fine-tuned identically on each benchmark; segmentation-based methods are pre-trained on images with the same organ masks, while MedVLMs use both image and text. Table 1 shows the quantitative performance of MedHiVE compared to existing baselines. MedHiVE consistently achieves the highest mDSC across all four benchmarks, PANORAMA, AMOS, KiTS, and GEPAR3D, demonstrating superior generalizability and robustness across diverse anatomical contexts. We evaluate the classification and detection performance against several state-of-the-art baselines on an independent external test set. MedHiVE outperforms all methods across all evaluation metrics, with significant gains ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test). Detailed results are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 下游任务. 我们对照关于分化、分类和检测的先进方法来评估MedHive。 为了进行公平的比较,所有方法都在同一数据集上进行预先训练,并在每个基准上进行相同的微调;基于分解的方法在具有相同器官口罩的图像上进行预先训练,而MedVLM同时使用图像和文字. 表1显示与现有基线相比,医疗喜病护理的量化性能。 MedHIVE在所有四项基准(PANORAMA、AMOS、KITS和GEPAR3D)中一贯实现最高的mDSC,表明在不同的解剖背景中具有超强的通性和强性。 我们对照独立外部测试组上的若干最新基线来评价分类和检测性能。 MedHiVE在所有评价指标中都超过了所有方法,并取得了显著的成绩(p < 0.05 p < 0.05,Wilcoxon签名排名测试)。 详细结果见附录E。

blocks.en: Qualitative results. We provide a qualitative comparison of MedHiVE against the top five performing baselines in Figure 3 , spanning four diverse datasets. Across all datasets, MedHiVE demonstrates a superior ability to delineate complex anatomical boundaries and maintain structural integrity in challenging regions. As highlighted by the red boxes, baseline methods frequently exhibit significant artifacts, such as over-segmentation in high-contrast regions or complete failure to capture small-scale lesions. In contrast, MedHiVE maintains high fidelity to the ground truth, particularly in cases of low-contrast boundaries where typical CNN and Transformer-based architectures produce fragmented or discontinuous predictions. More samples of qualitative results for PANORAMA, AMOS-CT, KiTS, and GEPAR3D are provided in Appendix G . We further apply the models fine-tuned on KiTS 2023 to a subset of the in-house cohort with kidney lesions and compare the predicted segmentations against the corresponding radiology reports, as voxel-wise annotations are unavailable for this dataset (see Figure 11 ). MedHiVE produces segmentations that agree with the reported findings, whereas Merlin and fVLM extend beyond lesion boundaries or segment lesions in kidneys the report does not describe, marked by red boxes.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: In this section, we investigate several factors affecting the performance of MedHiVE: (1) the impact of the key components, including text supervision and local-global contrastive learning; (2) the impact of individual architectural components, including the routing strategy. We pre-train each ablation using the Merlin [ 6 ] dataset and the same training setup. All hyperparameters (e.g., number of experts, groups, and slots) within HiVEL are selected following the ablations reported in MambaHoME [ 36 ] . The detailed ablation studies are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们调查了影响MedHive性能的几个因素:(1)关键组成部分的影响,包括文本监督和局部-全球对比性学习;(2)单个建筑组成部分的影响,包括路由策略. 我们使用梅林[6]数据集和相同的训练设置来预训每个衰竭. HIVEL中的所有超参数(如专家、小组和槽的数量)都是在MambaHOME所报道的喷发后选定的。 详细研究载于附录F。

blocks.en: Effect of the key components. Table 2 shows that adding text supervision alone already improves performance over the vision-only baseline (#1), indicating that report-derived semantics provide a complementary signal beyond anatomy masks. Introducing multi-granularity contrastive learning yields further gains (#2, #11), supporting our hypothesis that hierarchical alignment is not merely auxiliary supervision, but a mechanism that improves representation quality for downstream dense prediction. Table 12 further shows that gains concentrate where this supervision applies. Averaged over the 12 organs of AMOS covered by our anatomy inventory, mDSC improves by 2.7 from the baseline to full model, compared with 0.7 for the three organs outside it. Even on GEPAR3D, with dental anatomy and CBCT unseen in pre-training, the full model improves over the baseline by 1.6 (#1, #11). Similarly, although PDAC and kidney tumors are not pre-training classes, MedHiVE achieves the highest DSC on both (see Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 关键组成部分的效果。 表2显示,仅添加文本监督就已经比仅视基线(#1)提高了性能,表明报告衍生的语义提供了解剖口罩以外的补充信号. 引入多角度对比性学习可以产生进一步的增益(#2,#11),支持我们的假设,即分级校正不仅仅是辅助监督,而是提高下游密集预测的表达质量的机制. 表12还表明,收益集中在这种监督适用的地方。 平均而言,在我们的解剖清单所覆盖的12个AMOS器官中,mDSC从基线到完整模型增加了2.7个,而其外的三个器官则增加了0.7个。 即使是在GPAR3D上,在预训中也看不到牙科解剖学和CBCT,完整的模型比基线提高了1.6 (# 1, #11). 同样地,尽管PDAC和肾脏肿瘤不是预训课程,但MedHive在两者上都实现了最高的DSC(见附录E.

blocks.en: Effect of the individual architectural choices. Table 2 shows that replacing SMoE with a standard FFN degrades performance, indicating the benefit of dynamic expert routing (#3). Removing global contrastive alignment also reduces performance, suggesting that global scan–report alignment provides complementary supervision (#4). Removing second-level routing, where first-level outputs are used directly without fusing, or local routing leads to further drops, highlighting the importance of hierarchical processing (#5, #6). The table also shows that enabling text in all stages (#7) degrades performance. Confining text to the final stage alone (#8) is also worse than using the last two. This sensitivity to text placement points to a contribution from routing text through HiVEL that goes beyond the contrastive objectives alone. Top- k MoE performs comparably on AMOS and slightly better on KiTS, but falls behind on PANORAMA and GEPAR3D (#9), with soft routing achieving the higher average across the four benchmarks. Using fixed weights, with w G w_{G} and w L w_{L} both set to 1, does not outperform the adaptive multi-task weighting EMA approach (#10). Both the hierarchical routing design and multi-level alignment contribute to the performance (#11).
blocks.zh: 个别建筑选择的效果。 表2显示,用标准FFN取代SMOE会降低性能,表明动态专家出行途径的好处(#3). 取消全球对比性校正也降低了性能,表明全球扫描-报告校正提供了互补的监督(# 4. 删除第二级路由,即直接使用一级输出而不用引信,或局部路由导致进一步下降,凸显了分级处理(#5,#6)的重要性. 该表还显示,在所有阶段(# 7)的赋能文本会降低性能. 仅将文本封入最后阶段(#8)也比使用后两个更糟糕. 这种对文本放置的敏感性表明,通过 HIVEL 路由文本的贡献超越了对比性目标本身. blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present MedHiVE, a novel hierarchical MedVLM bridging the gap between global clinical semantics and fine-grained 3D anatomical details via a two-level SMoE routing mechanism and multi-granularity contrastive learning. By leveraging organ segmentation, MedHiVE aligns voxel-level features with corresponding report snippets across anatomical scales, outperforming state-of-the-art global and patch-based models. Ultimately, MedHiVE provides a scalable foundation for unified 3D medical vision-language understanding, with future work expanding toward longitudinal data.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了MedHiVE,一种新的分级的MedVLM,它通过一个两级的SMoE通路机制和多角度对比性学习,弥合了全球临床语义和精细的3D解剖细节之间的差距. 通过利用器官分解,MedHiVE将 voxel 级特征与相应的报告片段相协调,跨越解剖尺度,优于最先进的全球和补丁模型. 最终,MedHive为统一的3D医疗视觉语言理解提供了可扩展的基础,未来的工作将扩展到纵向数据。

blocks.en: We list 14 abdominal anatomical structures within CT scans and match the level of detail in radiology reports, as listed in Table 3 . The corresponding segmentation masks are sourced from the Merlin dataset [ 6 ] and used for pre-training. The masks were obtained through a semi-automatic human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline, in which initial organ masks generated by a pre-trained segmentation model were subsequently refined through iterative quality control and correction procedures. This aligns the fine-grained segmentations with the coarser terminology used in clinical practice, enabling direct comparison with radiologists’ descriptions. Furthermore, this process enhances compatibility with standardized reporting frameworks, facilitating downstream analysis and clinical integration. The masks are publicly available as part of Merlin Plus [ 3 ] . Figure 4 presents 2D axial, coronal, and sagittal views of these labels, while Figure 5 provides 3D visualizations.

blocks.en: To enable effective learning from the highly detailed segmentation masks, we directly extract anatomical structures with a more compact and semantically meaningful set of 14 anatomies (see Table 3 ). This consolidation reduces redundancy, improves class balance, and facilitates both visualization and downstream model training by focusing on anatomically coherent regions.

blocks.en: We convert each radiology report into anatomy-specific descriptions that supervise organ-level image and text alignment. We begin by standardizing terminology to a fixed inventory spanning organs, including, for example, the kidney, liver, and pancreas. To make the process robust across institutions and writing styles, each anatomy is associated with a curated set of case-insensitive regular-expression synonyms that cover common lexical variants (e.g., “renal” for kidney), laterality (left/right), lobar names, and frequent spellings. These mappings ensure that heterogeneous phrasing resolves to the same target anatomy.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个放射学报告 转换成解剖学的描述 来监督器官的图像和文本的对齐 我们首先将术语标准化为包括肾脏、肝脏和胰腺等器官在内的固定库存。 为了使这一过程在各机构和写作风格上都具有强势性,每个解剖学都与一套对案例不敏感、经常表达的同义词有关,这些同义词涵盖常见的词典变体(例如肾脏“肾脏”)、后起之分(左/右)、去巴名和频繁拼写。 这些绘图确保了不同措辞能够解决同一目标解剖问题。

blocks.en: For each study, we read the Findings and Impression sections from the report and decide, for each anatomy, whether the report actually discusses it. This “mention” decision combines two signals: a section-conditioned query to Qwen3-30B [ 48 ] , a recent LLM with long-context handling, and a synonym match using compiled regexes. All prompts used to extract reports at the organ-level and global level are provided in Section A.4 .
blocks.zh: 对于每项研究,我们读取报告中的 " 发现"和"印象"两部分,并针对每个解剖学,决定报告是否真的讨论它. 这一“提示”决定结合了两个信号:一个是给Qune3-30B [48] 的有分节条件的查询,一个是最近的LLM,有长通体处理,另一个是使用编译的regexs的同义词匹配. 用于在机关一级和全球一级提取报告的所有提示载于A.4节。

blocks.en: These anatomy-indexed texts are tokenized to form organ-level representations for local alignment, while the full report produces a global text representation. On the image side, anatomical segmentation masks are used to pool features from the corresponding regions in the 3D CT volume. In combination, anatomy-level image features and anatomy-specific report texts provide local supervision, while the whole-report/whole-image pair supplies global supervision.
blocks.zh: 这些有解剖索引的文本是象征性的,以形成用于局部对齐的机关级代表,而报告全文则产生全球文本代表. 在图像方面,解剖分解口罩用于集合3D CT卷中相应区域的特征. 综合起来,解剖学层面的图像特征和具体解剖学报告文本提供地方监督,而全报告/全图像对提供全球监督.

blocks.en: Following the automated stages of [ 4 ] , a dedicated quality control phase is applied to the report-derived snippets. To ensure clinical reliability, all anatomy-aware snippets were manually reviewed by four radiologists with at least 5 years of experience, and refined by a senior radiologist with over 30 years of clinical practice. This verification step focused on preserving anatomical coherence and ensuring that each extracted segment accurately reflects the corresponding content of the original radiology report.

blocks.en: Merlin. The Merlin dataset [ 3 , 6 ] represents one of the largest publicly available repositories for medical imaging research, comprising 25,494 3D computed tomography (CT) scans acquired from a diverse clinical cohort at Stanford Hospital. Unlike traditional segmentation datasets, Merlin is designed for multimodal clinical alignment, pairing high-resolution 3D volumetric data with a massive longitudinal corpus of approximately 1.8 million structured Electronic Health Record (EHR) diagnosis codes and over 6 million tokens of unstructured radiology reports. This integration allows for the development of models that can correlate complex visual features with patient history and clinical outcomes.

blocks.en: KiTS 2023. The KiTS dataset [ 18 ] represents the third and largest iteration of the Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation challenge, expanding significantly upon the foundations laid in 2019 and 2021. It comprises a total of 599 3D contrast-enhanced CT scans, with 489 cases provided for training and 110 reserved for a hidden test set. While previous versions focused primarily on the late arterial (corticomedullary) phase, KiTS 2023 introduces greater clinical heterogeneity by including scans from the nephrogenic contrast phase, reflecting a broader range of real-world diagnostic protocols. Each scan includes high-fidelity, voxel-level manual annotations for three primary semantic classes: healthy kidney parenchyma, kidney tumors (malignant suspects), and kidney cysts. The annotations were produced through a collaborative effort involving medical students and expert clinicians, ensuring high labeling accuracy even in cases with significant anatomical distortions. The dataset is characterized by extreme variability in target scales; tumor volumes range from small incidentalomas ( 0.2 ​ cm 3 0.2\text{ cm}^{3} ) to massive renal masses exceeding 2500 ​ cm 3 2500\text{ cm}^{3} . Geometrically, the scans feature in-plane resolutions between 0.43 ∼ 1.04 ​ mm 0.43\sim 1.04\text{ mm} and slice thicknesses ranging from 0.5 0.5 to 5.0 ​ mm 5.0\text{ mm} (with a median of 3.0 ​ mm 3.0\text{ mm} ).
blocks.zh: Kits 2023 (英语). KitS数据集 [18] 代表了"肾和肾肿瘤分化"挑战的第三次和最大规模的迭代,在2019年和2021年奠定的基础上大幅扩展. 它包括总共599个3D对比增强的CT扫描,其中489个病例用于培训,110个案例用于隐藏测试。 虽然之前的版本主要侧重于后动脉(corticomedulry)阶段,而Kits 2023则引入了更大的临床异质性,包括了取自肾上腺对比相的扫描,反映了更广泛的现实世界诊断协议. 每一次扫描都包含高纯度,活性水平的手动说明,用于三个初级语义类:健康的肾上腺瘤,肾肿瘤(恶性疑似)和肾囊肿. 该说明是通过医科学生和专家临床医生的共同努力编写的,确保了即使有严重解剖失常的情况也具有很高的准确性。 数据集的特点是目标尺度的极端可变性;肿瘤体积从小的附带瘤(0.2 cm 3 0.2\text{ cm}^{3})到超过2500cm 3,500\text{ cm}^{3}的大规模肾脏质. 从几何角度讲,扫描的特点是飞机内分辨率介于0.43 ∼ 1.04毫米 0.43\sim 1.04\text{mm}和从0.5到5.0毫米 5.0\text{mm}的切片厚度之间(中位数为3.0毫米 3.0\text{mm}).

blocks.en: AMOS-CT. The AMOS-CT dataset [ 23 ] consists of a total of 500 CT scans collected from diverse clinical centers, ensuring significant variability in scanner types and patient demographics. However, the ground truth labels are publicly accessible only for the training and validation cohorts, comprising 200 and 100 scans, respectively. Each volume provides high-quality, voxel-level manual annotations for 15 distinct abdominal organs: spleen, right kidney, left kidney, gallbladder, esophagus, liver, stomach, aorta, inferior vena cava, pancreas, right adrenal gland, left adrenal gland, duodenum, bladder, and prostate/uterus. For our experimental setup, we utilize the 200 training scans for model optimization and the 100 validation scans as our test set. The dataset is particularly challenging due to its large intra-class variation; for instance, the number of axial slices per scan ranges from 68 to 353, and the voxel spatial resolution varies significantly from ( [ 0.45 ∼ 1.07 ] × [ 0.45 ∼ 1.07 ] × [ 1.25 ∼ 5.0 ] [0.45\sim 1.07]\times[0.45\sim 1.07]\times[1.25\sim 5.0] ) mm 3 \text{mm}^{3} . The mean resolution is 0.70 × 0.70 × 4.20 0.70\times 0.70\times 4.20 mm 3 \text{mm}^{3} . Beyond its scale, AMOS-CT is recognized for including both healthy and pathological cases, requiring models to be robust against anatomical distortions and varied fields of view typical in real-world clinical environments.

blocks.en: GEPAR3D. We utilize the GEPAR3D dataset, which is derived from 98 publicly available Cone-Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) scans originally released by [ 12 ] . While the initial iteration of this data provided only binary masks (distinguishing tooth structure from background), it presented significant limitations for tasks requiring individual tooth identification or pathological analysis. To address this, [ 42 ] performed an extensive manual reannotation process. Experienced clinicians labeled the dataset into 32 distinct anatomical classes following the FDI World Dental Federation notation, effectively transforming it into a benchmark for fine-grained multi-class dental segmentation. The dataset is characterized by its high anatomical complexity, featuring diverse dental conditions including restorations and implants that introduce metallic artifacts, varying stages of tooth decay and bone loss, and impacted teeth and irregular dental alignments.

blocks.en: In-house abdominal CT. We curated a comprehensive and diverse dataset comprising 2,577 CECT abdominal scans obtained from a longitudinal study of 1,740 unique patients, all captured in the portal-venous phase to ensure optimal enhancement of parenchymal organs and venous structures. Within this cohort, the dataset includes 414 cases with histopathology-confirmed Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC), while the remaining cases are treated as a normal cohort for comparative analysis. The dataset’s primary strength lies in its aggregation from 80 distinct medical centers, which introduces a high degree of technical and clinical heterogeneity essential for developing robust and generalizable diagnostic models. By sourcing data from such a wide array of institutions, we account for significant variations in hardware manufacturers and technical acquisition parameters, such as differing tube voltages, current settings, and reconstruction kernels. This multi-center approach also captures a broad range of institutional protocols regarding contrast media injection rates and timing, ensuring the data reflects real-world clinical variability rather than the specific biases of a single facility. We utilize this dataset to validate models for both the classification and detection of PDAC at the patient-level, leveraging the multi-institutional diversity to ensure high diagnostic reliability across varying clinical environments.
blocks.zh: 内部腹部CT. 我们整理了一套全面和多样的数据集,其中包括从对1 740名独有患者的纵向研究中获取的2 577个CECT腹部扫描数据,所有这些患者都在门户-复仇阶段被捕获,以确保最优化地增强阴道器官和阴道结构。 在这个组群中,该数据集包括414个经组织病理学确认的Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma(PDAC)病例,其余病例作为普通组群进行比较分析。 数据集的主要优点在于它来自80个不同的医疗中心,这些中心引入了对开发强大而通俗的诊断模型至关重要的高度技术和临床异质性。 通过从如此多的机构获取数据,我们说明了硬件制造商和技术获取参数的显著变化,例如不同的管电压、电流设置和重建内核。 这种多中心方法还包含关于对比介质注射率和时间的广泛体制协议,确保数据反映现实世界的临床可变性,而不是单一设施的具体偏差。 我们利用这个数据集验证在病人一级进行多机构诊断和检测的模型,利用多机构的多样性,确保不同临床环境具有高的诊断可靠性。

blocks.en: In-house kidney dataset. We selected a subset of 100 In-house abdominal CT scans with kidney tumors and cysts to evaluate our proposed MedHiVE alongside state-of-the-art methods. blocks.en: Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC). The Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) serves as our primary measure of regional overlap. Formally, for a multi-class segmentation task with C C classes, we represent the prediction and ground truth at each voxel i i as one-hot encoded vectors 𝐩 i , 𝐠 i ∈ { 0 , 1 } C \mathbf{p}_{i},\mathbf{g}_{i}\in\{0,1\}^{C} . The DSC for class c c is defined as the harmonic mean of precision and recall: D ​ S ​ C c = 2 ​ ∑ i p i , c ​ g i , c ∑ i p i , c + ∑ i g i , c . DSC_{c}=\frac{2\sum_{i}p_{i,c}g_{i,c}}{\sum_{i}p_{i,c}+\sum_{i}g_{i,c}}. The global performance is summarized via the mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (mDSC): mDSC = 1 C ​ ∑ c = 1 C D ​ S ​ C c \text{mDSC}=\frac{1}{C}\sum_{c=1}^{C}DSC_{c} . Unlike voxel accuracy, mDSC is invariant to the absolute volume of the background, making it particularly effective for medical datasets where the regions of interest (e.g., lesions or small organs) occupy a negligible fraction of the total volume. Mathematically, the DSC can be viewed as an approximation of the L 1 L_{1} distance between the binary masks, normalized by their total cardinality.

blocks.en: Boundary-based Assessment: 95th Percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95). While DSC captures volumetric overlap, it is often insensitive to small, localized boundary deviations which can be clinically significant. To quantify surface alignment, we employ the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95). Let S c P S_{c}^{P} and S c G S_{c}^{G} denote the sets of points on the boundaries of the predicted and ground truth regions for class c c . The bi-directional Hausdorff distance is typically defined as: d H ​ ( S c P , S c G ) = max ⁡ ( sup p ∈ S c P inf g ∈ S c G ‖ p − g ‖ 2 , sup g ∈ S c G inf p ∈ S c P ‖ g − p ‖ 2 ) . d_{H}(S_{c}^{P},S_{c}^{G})=\max\big(\sup_{p\in S_{c}^{P}}\inf_{g\in S_{c}^{G}}\|p-g\|_{2},\;\;\sup_{g\in S_{c}^{G}}\inf_{p\in S_{c}^{P}}\|g-p\|_{2}\big). (23) However, the standard Hausdorff distance is highly sensitive to outliers—single misclassified voxels far from the ground truth can disproportionately inflate the error. Following standard practice in medical imaging benchmarks, we adopt the 95th percentile of the ordered distances, denoted as H ​ D ​ 95 c HD95_{c} . This robust variant provides a more stable estimate of the “maximum” distance between the two surfaces. We report the mean HD95 (mHD95) averaged across all classes to provide a comprehensive view of spatial boundary fidelity.

blocks.en: Clinical Detection Metrics. To assess the model’s diagnostic utility at the patient level, we evaluate Sensitivity and Specificity. We categorize each patient-level prediction as True Positive ( T ​ P TP ), False Positive ( F ​ P FP ), False Negative ( F ​ N FN ), or True Negative ( T ​ N TN ) based on the presence of the segmented condition. Sensitivity (True Positive Rate) and Specificity (True Negative Rate) are defined as: Sensitivity = T ​ P T ​ P + F ​ N , Specificity = T ​ N T ​ N + F ​ P . \text{Sensitivity}=\frac{TP}{TP+FN},\quad\text{Specificity}=\frac{TN}{TN+FP}. These metrics characterize the model’s trade-off between detection coverage and the minimization of false alarms, both of which are critical for clinical integration.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Quantitative multi-organ segmentation performance on the AMOS-CT dataset. The evaluation encompasses 15 distinct anatomical structures across a wide range of scales and morphologies. mDSC is reported in (%) and mHD95 in (mm), with the best results per category indicated in bold . blocks.en: To further validate the empirical performance of MedHiVE, we provide an extensive qualitative comparison across four diverse medical imaging benchmarks: PANORAMA, AMOS-CT, KiTS 2023, and GEPAR3D. While quantitative metrics offer a statistical overview of performance, the following visualizations demonstrate the model’s ability to resolve complex anatomical challenges that standard metrics may not fully capture—specifically regarding topological connectivity and boundary fidelity.

blocks.en:
Hierarchical medical vision–language models such as MedHiVE are best
viewed as assistive technology: they learn volumetric features
that cohere with how radiologists describe anatomy in free text, which
can reduce repetitive manual work, speed up research cohort
construction, and improve access to structured imaging cues in
resource-constrained settings. In practice, the same class of model
could support draft contouring for treatment planning, quality assurance
on routine cross-sectional studies, retrieval of similar prior cases,
and teaching tools that link scrollable volumes to report language.
Because MedHiVE separates local token routing from global
vision–language fusion, downstream systems can in principle highlight which image regions and which phrases contribute to a
prediction—a property that matters for auditability and for training
junior readers, provided uncertainty is communicated honestly.

The public benchmarks we evaluate are examples of these use
cases, not an exhaustive clinical product specification. Work on
pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in portal-venous abdominal CT
illustrates how better multi-structure segmentation could ease contouring
for chemoradiation or surgical planning, while leaving resectability,
margin assessment, and staging decisions to the treating team.
Conversely, fine-grained three-dimensional tooth segmentation on
cone-beam CT (as in GEPAR3D) illustrates the same principle outside
abdominal radiology: sharper tooth-level masks can assist orthodontic,
implant, and maxillofacial planning software, but metal artifact,
missing teeth, and atypical anatomy still require interactive human
review. Across domains, any deployment must be preceded by local
validation, clear human-in-the-loop governance, and—where a product is
intended for care—the appropriate regulatory pathway. MedHiVE has
not been evaluated in a prospective reader study and is not a
certified medical device; it should not be used to make treatment
decisions without expert oversight.

blocks.en: Appendix I Limitations and future directions
blocks.zh: 附录一 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: While MedHiVE demonstrates significant improvements in 3D multi-modal understanding, a few limitations remain that offer avenues for future research.
blocks.zh: 虽然MedHIVE在三维多式理解方面显示出了显著的改进,但仍存在一些局限性,为今后的研究提供了途径。

blocks.en: Fixed anatomical inventory. The current framework operates on a predefined set of 14 anatomical structures, which covers the most clinically relevant regions in the evaluated datasets. While this design enables stable and interpretable anatomy-level alignment, it may limit coverage of rare or fine-grained structures. Importantly, our results indicate that the learned representations still generalize beyond these regions through global context. Extending the inventory or incorporating more flexible anatomical representations is a direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 固定解剖清单. 目前的框架以一套预先界定的由14个解剖结构组成的结构运作,这些结构涵盖被评价数据集中最临床相关的区域. 虽然这种设计能够使解剖学层次的对齐稳定且可解释,但可能会限制稀有或精细结构的覆盖. 重要的是,我们的结果表明,从全球范围看,从这些区域之外仍然普遍看到学到的经验。 扩大清单或纳入更灵活的解剖说明是今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: Data biases. The model is trained on large-scale clinical data, where the frequency of anatomical descriptions follows real-world reporting patterns. As a result, commonly discussed organs are more densely represented than less frequently mentioned regions. While this reflects realistic clinical distributions and does not prevent strong performance across benchmarks, it may influence sensitivity to rare findings. Future work could explore reweighting strategies or targeted sampling to further improve performance on underrepresented anatomies. The development of MedHiVE opens several promising directions for extending hierarchical vision-language modeling in the medical domain.
blocks.zh: 数据偏差。 该模型接受了大规模临床数据的培训,其中解剖描述的频率遵循了现实世界的报告模式. 因此,与较少提到的区域相比,通常讨论的机关的代表性更为密集。 虽然这反映了现实的临床分布,并不妨碍跨越基准的强劲表现,但可能影响对罕见发现的敏感性. 今后的工作可以探索重新加权战略或有针对性地取样,以进一步改善代表性不足的解剖的绩效。 MedHiVE的发展为在医学领域推广分级视觉语言模型开辟了几个有希望的方向.

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary anatomical grounding. A primary goal for future iterations is to move beyond a fixed anatomical inventory. By integrating open-vocabulary object detection techniques with our hierarchical routing, the model could potentially align visual tokens with arbitrary clinical concepts mentioned in reports, such as specific lesions or rare vascular anomalies, without requiring predefined masks. This would transition the system from an “organ-centric” model to a “pathology-centric” one.
blocks.zh: 开口解剖地基. 未来重复的一个主要目标是超越固定的解剖清单。 通过将开放式活性物体检测技术与我们的分级路由相结合,该模型有可能使视觉标志与报告中提及的任意临床概念相配合,如特定的损伤或罕见血管异常,而不需要预先定义的口罩. 这将把系统从“以器官为中心的”模式转变为“以病理为中心的”模式。

blocks.en: Longitudinal integration of imaging and clinical context. Clinical diagnosis often relies on the evolution of findings over time. Extending the Mamba-based backbone to handle 4D data (3D volumes over multiple time points) would allow the model to capture disease progression. This would require the MedHiVE to route information not only across spatial scales but also across temporal sequences, while incorporating tokens derived from longitudinal clinical context beyond radiology reports (e.g., pathology results, operative notes, laboratory trends, or prior diagnoses) to align imaging changes with the evolving clinical narrative.
blocks.zh: 成像与临床环境纵向结合. 临床诊断往往依赖于研究结果随时间推移而演变. 扩大以曼巴为主干线处理4D数据(多个时间点的3D卷),将使模型能够捕捉疾病进展. 这将要求医疗与发展研究所不仅在空间尺度上,而且在时间序列上提供路由信息,同时在放射学报告(如病理学结果、操作说明、实验室趋势或事先诊断)之外纳入从纵向临床背景得出的信号,使成像变化与不断演变的临床叙述保持一致。

blocks.en: Multi-modality validation. We aim to evaluate the generalizability of the MedHiVE framework across different imaging modalities, such as MRI and PET-CT, and across diverse patient populations from multiple clinical sites. This would involve studying the domain-shift robustness of the hierarchical routers when encountering different scanner protocols and reporting styles.
blocks.zh: 多式联运验证。 我们的目标是评估MedHive框架在诸如核磁共振和PET-CT等不同成像模式以及来自多个临床地点的不同病人群体中的普遍性。 这将涉及在遇到不同的扫描仪协议和报告风格时,研究分级路由器的域位变化稳健性。

Negative societal impacts and mitigations. Like all data-driven medical models, MedHiVE can inherit and amplify documentation bias (who is scanned, which findings are written
down, and how reports are phrased), scanner and site bias , and
errors or shortcuts in automated preprocessing (e.g., LLM-based snippet extraction). Confident but incorrect
associations between images and text could contribute to
misdiagnosis, over-investigation, or inappropriate automation if
integrated into clinical workflows without calibration, uncertainty
communication, and governance. Deployment also imposes privacy obligations: training on patient data must follow institutional
review, data-use agreements, and de-identification standards appropriate
to each jurisdiction.
We therefore position MedHiVE as a methodological building block,
not a turnkey clinical product. We encourage translation efforts to
prioritize prospective evaluation, fairness and robustness auditing
across sites and demographics, clinician oversight, and transparent
reporting of limitations, including failure modes under distribution
shift and imperfect text or segmentation supervision.
